A Claude CRM That’s Tried, Tested, and True

A Claude CRM means using Anthropic’s Claude AI assistant alongside a traditional CRM platform like HubSpot. The goal is not to replace the CRM but to give Claude access to it — so reps can get AI-generated insights, automate pre-call briefs, and analyze pipeline without leaving Claude’s interface or manually copying data across tools.
Founders, RevOps leaders, and sales and marketing teams benefit most when Claude can act on real CRM context rather than whatever information gets pasted into a prompt.
Why HubSpot is a Strong CRM for Claude Users

How to Connect Claude to HubSpot

Users can connect Claude to HubSpot by going to Claude’s connector directory and authorizing access. Once connected, Claude can read and act on their HubSpot context without switching tools. Click to access the connector without browsing.

To set up the HubSpot connector for Claude for the first time, a user must be a HubSpot Super Admin or have HubSpot Marketplace permissions. They can then select the allowed permissions and give access to other users across teams and departments that can connect to it, too.

Whoever sets up the connector (Super Admins or non-admins alike) will also need access to an active HubSpot user account and an active Claude account. The HubSpot account can be registered under the free tier. The Claude account (where the connector “lives”) must have a paid Anthropic subscription (Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise).
If all that’s in place, follow these exact steps to connect Claude to HubSpot, enabling your Claude CRM:
In your Claude account, select your profile icon in the bottom left.
Click Settings. On the left, click Connectors.
On the Web tab, select HubSpot.
Click Add to your team. Close the dialog box.
Click Connect next to HubSpot. In the dialog box, select and log in to the HubSpot account you’d like to use with Claude.
On the Connecting HubSpot Connector for Claude to HubSpot page, select the permissions you want to grant to the connector. Then click Connect app.
After connecting, you’ll be redirected back to the Claude chat window. You can now use the connector.
Here’s how to give other users access to the connector:
In your HubSpot account, click the settings icon in the top navigation bar. In the left sidebar menu, navigate to Integrations > Connected Apps.
Click the HubSpot connector for Claude.
On the Overview tab, in the top right, click Give users access.
Click Give Access to allow every user in your account to use the connector.
Now that access is enabled for other users, they can start connecting to the HubSpot CRM via their Claude accounts.
What Claude Can See and Do in HubSpot

The HubSpot connector for Claude allows Claude to view, create, and update HubSpot context from within the chat window. So the connector can create and update CRM records and log activities. However, Claude only sees what a company has authorized, and only what the account already has access to in the connected tool. Another thing to note is that Claude can’t delete anything.
Here’s a more in-depth look at what Claude can see and do with the HubSpot connector in place:

Viewing (read behavior). Claude can view standard CRM objects like contacts, companies, deals, and tickets, as well as custom objects, products, and billing records. The connector also surfaces engagement history including emails, calls, meetings, tasks, and notes.
Creating and updating (write behavior). Claude can create new contacts and deals, update record properties including deal stage, log notes on records, and create tasks and follow-ups.
Delete operations. The HubSpot connector does not support delete operations. Claude cannot remove data from records on behalf of a user.
Pro tip: Configure the HubSpot connector to always request approval before making updates. In Claude, navigate to the HubSpot connector tool settings and set Write tools to Needs Approval.
Here’s an overview of what access the Claude connector has to HubSpot objects, broken down into read, create, update, and delete functions:

The connector respects existing HubSpot permissions. Setup requires a Super Admin or a user with HubSpot Marketplace permissions. Only that user can authorize other team members to connect their Claude accounts to HubSpot. Users with a Partner seat need either Partner Admin or Super Admin permissions.

To grant additional access — for example, to campaigns, users, or new insight data — a Super Admin must disconnect and reconnect the connector. Each relevant user will then need to reconnect to access the specific tools they want to use.
Pro tip: If the HubSpot account has Sensitive Data turned on, Claude cannot access engagement data for added security.
When using create and update actions through the connector, attribution is recorded in HubSpot’s Audit Log against both the user and the Claude connector.
Claude CRM Use Cases in HubSpot
Here are nine real-world Claude CRM use cases in HubSpot for sales, marketing, and service workflows.

Through HubSpot CRM, organizations can track active deals, total revenue potential, and movement across the sales pipeline. Knowing how to use Claude for sales enables teams to request summaries of active deals organized by name, amount, and stage.
Sales teams can request a summary of active deals organized by name, amount, and stage. Results can also be visualized as charts and graphs within Claude based on the HubSpot context.

Pro tip: For teams that want dedicated sales workflows built directly into Claude, the HubSpot Sales Plugin for Claude includes prebuilt skills for call prep, pipeline review, daily briefs, and follow-up drafting.

With the connector, sales teams can ask Claude to summarize all existing conversations with a company or prospect from a set time frame. Claude can then identify any issues that might affect deal closure and draft a follow-up email based on that context. Sales teams can also ask Claude to generate follow-up emails based on the existing activities, tasks, and notes against a prospect or client’s record in HubSpot.

One of the core benefits of a CRM is centralizing customer data in a single place, and automating CRM with generative AI through the HubSpot connector for Claude streamlines routine tasks and frees up rep time for higher-value work. With the connector in place, contacts and deals can be updated directly from the Claude chat window — without switching to HubSpot.
Sales teams can ask Claude to handle CRM data maintenance tasks like updating lead status, logging call notes, and scoring leads.

HubSpot’s lifecycle stages allow marketing teams to categorize contacts and companies based on where they sit in the customer journey. Subscriber and Lead are two default stages. A Subscriber has opted into a blog or newsletter. A Lead has converted through a website interaction or other engagement beyond a subscription.

With the connector in place, marketing teams can ask Claude to analyze time spent in each lifecycle stage over a given period. Contacts can then be segmented by that timeline to help teams prioritize converting Subscribers and warm Leads into Customers before interest fades.

With the HubSpot connector in place, marketing teams can ask Claude to analyze campaign performance. Claude can surface which campaigns generated the most revenue in a given period and break down performance by channel. Marketing email analysis is also available — including which subject lines drove the most clicks. From there, teams can prompt Claude to create or update marketing emails based on that analysis.

Marketing teams can use Claude to analyze specific HubSpot contacts based on engagement history including emails, calls, meetings, tasks, and notes. For broader campaign planning, Claude can compare up to five contact lists or segments side by side and analyze how contacts typically move from leads to customers.

Service teams can use a Claude CRM built on HubSpot records to add and understand ticket context. Individual reps can ask Claude to log a note summarizing their approach to resolving a ticket, keeping the record current without switching tools.

Team leads can ask Claude for context across all open tickets assigned to a specific rep, sorted by priority and creation date. If the rep used Claude to log resolution notes, that context is also accessible in the same workflow.

A service team lead with access to the HubSpot connector for Claude can save time by using AI to summarize ticket and contact data. Teams can ask Claude to summarize the most common questions across inbox or help desk channels in a given period, then follow up with a prompt to identify trending issues.

The HubSpot connector for Claude allows service teams to query CRM data and get actionable next-step suggestions about individual customers, companies, or entire service approaches. A service team lead can ask Claude to compare resolution approaches and outcomes across support channels, then request next-step suggestions to drive consistency and quality based on the analysis.

Of the 700+ data experts surveyed from around the globe, 80% said AI is making data security more challenging. Common AI data protection issues include the leakage of sensitive information and bad actors gaming or jailbreaking systems, as some AI models are more easily fooled than others. When integrating any AI into a business, the best defense against poor internal practices and bad external actors is a good offense.

Organizations must first have the necessary data governance frameworks and permissions to ensure a successful (and secure!) rollout. Thankfully, the important stuff like role-based access, respecting existing permissions, and auditability comes by default with the HubSpot connector for Claude.
Let’s take a closer look at what this means to a company:

Role-based access. Only a Super Admin or a user with HubSpot Marketplace permissions in an organization’s HubSpot account can set up the connector in the first instance. That means someone without the correct authority and sign-off can never activate it. The Super Admin or a user with HubSpot Marketplace permissions can then give access to other users.

Existing permissions. Once the connector is activated, it will respect any existing permissions set for HubSpot users by the Super Admin. These permissions control what users can view, create, or edit in an account. Super Admins can also limit edit access to properties and assign content access for specific users. Furthermore, if a HubSpot account has Sensitive Data enabled, Claude cannot access any engagement data for added security.

Auditability. HubSpot’s Audit Log records user logins, security changes, and system modifications. When a user performs a create or update action in the HubSpot connector for Claude, it will be recorded in your HubSpot account’s Audit Log for both the user and the Claude connector.
Is HubSpot the right Claude CRM for your team?

HubSpot is a strong fit for teams that want to unify fragmented sales, marketing, and service data into a single AI CRM software tool, and with that context in place, Claude can take action on real data.

HubSpot is also a strong fit for founders building robust data governance into a Claude CRM rollout. The HubSpot connector supports role-based access, respects existing permissions, and provides an audit trail for both the user and the connector.

For sales, marketing, and service teams that need a Claude CRM to support practical, real-world workflows, HubSpot offers validated use cases rather than untested AI claims. The connector supports the following workflows:
Sales teams can create and update HubSpot CRM records, including contacts and deals, from the Claude chat window.
Marketing teams can analyze marketing email performance and create and update marketing emails.
Service teams can log activities, tasks, and notes in HubSpot directly from the Claude chat window.

A potential trade-off is that the HubSpot connector for Claude doesn’t support delete operations. That means Claude cannot delete information from a user’s records. However, this adds an extra layer of protection for an organization, because it means Claude can’t accidentally delete a ton of important contact information.
